description: Command-line tool and Node.js wrapper for the Mermaid library to render diagrams from text definitions
auth_notes: Mermaid CLI is an open-source local library and CLI tool requiring no authentication.
credential_notes: Free and open source under the MIT license, available via npm or Docker without credentials.
api_notes: Exposes a CLI command (mmdc) and a programmatic Node.js function (`run`) to transform text definitions into images.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by the vendor.
rationale: It is a fully open-source local tool that can be immediately installed and executed via CLI or Node.js without any credentials or web APIs.

evidence.note: Shows installation via npm/Docker and usage of the open-source Mermaid CLI.
Documents the Node.js API import { run } from '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli'.
